meta.name: brainstorm-ideas-new
meta.description: Brainstorm feature ideas for a new product in initial discovery from PM, Designer, and Engineer perspectives. Use when starting product discovery for a new product, exploring features for a startup idea, or doing initial ideation.

copy.tagline: 从多角色视角构思新产品功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在启动新产品发现阶段，需要多角色视角的创意输入。
copy.tagline_en: Brainstorm product features from multiple role perspectives
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are starting product discovery for a new product and need diverse perspectives.

howto.what: 当你描述一个新产品的目标用户和机会后，它会从产品经理、设计师和工程师三个角度分别生成5个功能创意，然后选出最重要的5个并说明理由和待验证的假设。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新产品的初期探索，比如有了一个创业想法或需要为新产品构思功能时，可以触发这个技能。

say.text: 我想做一个帮助老年人学习智能手机的App，帮我 brainstorm 功能。
say.note: 它会从三个角色视角生成功能点子。

say.text: 我们有个面向小企业的记账软件想法，请从PM、设计师和工程师角度出主意。
say.note: 它会分别产出各角色的创意。

howto.what_en: When you describe a new product's target users and opportunity, it generates 5 feature ideas from PM, Designer, and Engineer perspectives each, then prioritizes the top 5 with reasoning and assumptions to test.
howto.when_en: Trigger when starting initial product discovery for a new product, exploring features for a startup idea, or doing initial ideation.

say_en.text: I want to build an app helping seniors learn smartphones. Brainstorm features.
say_en.note: It generates ideas from three perspectives.

say_en.text: We have an idea for small business accounting software. Ideate from PM, Designer, Engineer views.
